tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Free. Start here: every tool with its price in USD, required arguments, what it returns, the x402 payment terms (USDC on Solana mainnet, payTo, facilitator) and the label semantics URL. Returns JSON.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Free. Feed health: feed_lag_s (seconds between the newest event in our tape and now), is_stale, last Solana slot, mints tracked, counters. Call it before trusting a card's freshness.

tools.name: market_regime
tools.description: Free. pump.fun market regime meter: launches per minute, mayhem share, curve buys/sells per minute, fail share, pool swaps, migrations vs true graduations (curve witnessed >= 84 SOL) in the last hour, rug flags per hour, history totals. No arguments. Returns JSON.

tools.name: sample_mint
tools.description: Free. One full risk card (the exact paid mint_risk_card shape) for a mint aged >= 300 s with >= 3 buys, delayed. Use it to see every field before paying. No arguments.

tools.name: check_coverage
tools.description: Free. Check full live coverage and <= 5 s feed freshness for one to five pump.fun mints before paying. Returns availability and exact prices.

tools.name: watchlist_updates
tools.description: Free. Initialize a watch cursor or check for new documented risk/lifecycle events for the same one to five mints. Returns availability only; a paid check returns event details and an updated cursor. Cursor lasts 24 h. Poll every 15 s or slower.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_coverage, check_pumpfun_risk, check_watchlist_risk · Private data: check_pumpfun_risk, mint_risk_card, creator_reputation, wallet_profile, rhc_curve_card · Public sink: market_regime, wallet_profile, rhc_recent_launches, rhc_curve_card · Destructive: recent_launches.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_coverage, check_pumpfun_risk, check_watchlist_risk · Private data: check_pumpfun_risk, mint_risk_card, creator_reputation, wallet_profile, rhc_curve_card · Public sink: market_regime, wallet_profile, rhc_recent_launches, rhc_curve_card · Destructive: recent_launches

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
